asked: # Build: Look tokens + settings levels (Fable rebuild) Started from the Build manager ("Start build now"). Model: fable. Work on branch `fable/apply-all-levels-fable` (create it from origin/main), commit there, push it and open a PR. Never merge it. ## What to build Fable recommended, Opus chosen. [Fable] look@1 fixture + reference engine review, replace the Opus engine (~30 min) 2. [Fable] Banner Apply to all on the reviewed engine (~30 min) 3. [Fable] settings-ui@1 levels review + Sliders (~30 min) 4.
